CommunityApplications.Profile:
AoNarr is a self-hosted media manager that unifies Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr/Readarr/Prowlarr/Bazarr/Whisparr-style functionality across 10 library types (Movies, TV Shows, Anime, Music, Books, Comics, ROMs, Online Videos, Courses, Adult) in one app.
This repository hosts the Unraid Community Applications templates for AoNarr:
- **aonarr** — the single all-in-one container (API + browser UI together). Recommended for most users. - **aonarr-server** — the API/backend-only container, for running the backend and web UI as two independently-scalable containers. - **aonarr-web** — the browser-UI-only container, pairs with `aonarr-server`.
For support, bug reports, and feature requests, open an issue on the GitHub repository below.
